name: nginx-multisite
description: Configures Nginx as a multi-site web server for three SSL-enabled virtual hosts, including document roots, sample pages, security settings, firewall rules, and SSH hardening.

name: cache
description: Installs and configures Memcached and Redis caching services, including Redis authentication, logging, service enablement, and listener configuration.

name: fastapi-tutorial
description: Installs Python and PostgreSQL prerequisites, deploys the FastAPI tutorial application, provisions its database and environment, and runs it as a systemd service.
